name: East Turkestan Republic (1933–1934)

colors.symbolism: the sky and the Turkic peoples

description: A sky-blue field with a white crescent and five-pointed star — the Kök Bayraq ('sky-blue banner').
history: Flag of the First East Turkestan Republic proclaimed at Kashgar in 1933; the Kök Bayraq remains the banner of Uyghur identity and is banned in China.
